title: Etiquette (Adab)
paragraphs: Sejak kecil, kakek Fahim selalu mengingatkannya bahwa bersikap sopan berarti lebih dari sekadar mengucapkan tolong dan terima kasih; itu berarti benar-benar memperhatikan bagaimana kata-kata dan tindakannya memengaruhi orang di sekitarnya.

Suatu malam, Fahim melihat tetangga baru pindah sendirian, kesulitan membawa beberapa kotak berat. Alih-alih berjalan melewatinya seperti kebanyakan penghuni lain, ia berhenti dan menawarkan bantuan tanpa diminta.

Tetangga itu berterima kasih dengan hangat dan kemudian menyebutkan kepada penghuni lain betapa terkejutnya ia, karena ia mengira tidak akan ada yang di gedung itu yang mau memperhatikan orang asing yang kesulitan sendirian.

Fahim kemudian menyadari bahwa pelajaran kakeknya bukan tentang sopan santun tertentu, melainkan tentang tetap peka terhadap kesempatan untuk berbuat baik, bahkan kepada orang yang hampir tidak kita kenal atau mungkin tidak akan pernah kita temui lagi.
answerKey: Growing up, Fahim's grandfather always reminded him that being polite meant more than simply saying please and thank you; it meant genuinely paying attention to how his words and actions affected people around him. One evening, Fahim noticed a new neighbor moving in alone, struggling with several heavy boxes. Rather than walking past like most other residents did, he stopped and offered his help without being asked. The neighbor thanked him warmly and later mentioned to another resident how surprised she was, since she had assumed nobody in the building would bother noticing a stranger struggling on their own. Fahim later realized that his grandfather's lesson was less about specific manners and more about staying alert to opportunities for kindness, even toward people we barely know or may never see again.
